svg.title: CFAR federation overview
svg.desc: Two CABE Domains each contain an Agent and a Key Service. A protected Envelope and FLP cross untrusted transport. The Target Agent requests access from its local Key Service, which recovers the Lease Key material and applies its Policy without contacting the Origin Domain.

g.aria-label: No live Origin request during Target resolution
